condition.zh: 慢性病 · 術前評估門診

tagline.zh: 手術那天的驚喜，要在一週前就拆掉
tagline.en: Surprises on the day of surgery are defused a week earlier

desc.zh: 問病史、算風險、看氣道、決定要不要延期。你今天的工作是讓手術那天沒有驚喜。
desc.en: History, risk, airway, and the decision to postpone or proceed. Your job today is a surgery day without surprises.

desc.zh: 病人先經過你：血壓、血糖、用藥袋、禁食衛教。聽到不對勁的聲音，你第一個知道。
desc.en: Patients reach you first: blood pressure, glucose, the bag of pills, fasting advice. When something sounds wrong, you know first.

about.zh: 門診日不哼歌，改成問問題。口袋裡還是那張手寫檢核卡。口頭禪：「手術那天不是用來發現事情的。」
about.en: No humming on clinic days; she asks questions instead. Same hand-written card in her pocket. Catchphrase: 'The day of surgery is not for finding things out.'

about.zh: 明天的病人今天就被她看過一遍。量血壓的時候會順便問「早餐吃了嗎」，答案常常很重要。
about.en: Tomorrow's patients have already been through her today. While taking the blood pressure she asks 'did you have breakfast?' The answer often matters.

role.zh: 病人：疝氣修補術前評估

about.zh: 六十二歲水電師傅，糖尿病打胰島素，半年前心臟裝了支架。以為「來醫院就要禁食」，昨晚十二點後沒吃，胰島素照打。
about.en: Sixty-two, plumber, insulin-treated diabetes, a coronary stent six months ago. Believes 'hospital means fasting', so nothing since midnight, insulin taken as usual.

about.zh: 包包裡永遠有一包糖果。口頭禪：「他就是不聽。」
about.en: Always has sweets in her handbag. Catchphrase: 'He never listens.'

role.zh: 病人：人工膝關節術前評估

about.zh: 七十歲退休音樂老師，脊椎側彎，十年前做過腰椎融合。朋友換膝蓋用半身麻醉「很舒服」，她也想要。功能容量：還在教會踩管風琴踏板。
about.en: Seventy, retired music teacher, scoliosis and a lumbar fusion ten years ago. Her friend had a 'lovely' spinal for her knee and she wants the same. Functional capacity: still works the organ pedals at church.

about.zh: 柯先生的支架是他放的。對「停藥」兩個字特別敏感。
about.en: He put in Mr Ko's stent. Particularly sensitive to the words 'stop the tablets'.

about.zh: 等候區的病人嘴巴在動，他一定看得到。
about.en: If a patient in the holding bay is chewing, he will see it.

about.zh: 家屬在床邊隨口說的一句話，她會記下來打給你。
about.en: A throwaway remark from a relative at the bedside: she writes it down and calls you.

plain.zh: 麻醉前用來描述病人整體健康狀況的一到六級。數字越大，風險越高，但它不是用來拒絕手術的。
plain.en: A one-to-six scale describing a patient's overall health before anaesthesia. Higher means riskier; it is not a tool for refusing surgery.

plain.zh: 病人平常能做多少事：爬兩層樓、提菜籃、踩管風琴踏板。這比很多檢查更能預測手術風險。
plain.en: What a patient can do day to day: two flights of stairs, the shopping, the organ pedals. It predicts surgical risk better than many tests.

plain.zh: 睡覺時呼吸道反覆塌陷、暫停呼吸。打鼾、白天想睡、脖子粗是線索。麻醉後比較容易呼吸抑制。
plain.en: The airway repeatedly collapses during sleep. Snoring, daytime sleepiness and a thick neck are clues; breathing is more fragile after anaesthesia.

plain.zh: 心臟支架後要吃的兩種抗血小板藥，防止支架裡長血塊。隨便停藥，支架可能在幾天內塞住。
plain.en: The two antiplatelet tablets taken after a coronary stent to stop clot forming inside it. Stop them carelessly and the stent can block within days.

plain.zh: 撐開狹窄心臟血管的小金屬網管。放支架後的頭幾個月，是擇期手術最危險的時期。
plain.en: A small metal mesh tube that props open a narrowed heart artery. The first months after a stent are the riskiest time for elective surgery.

plain.zh: 血糖太低。冒冷汗、發抖、講話不清楚、昏沉。糖尿病人禁食卻照常打胰島素，是門診最常見的原因。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, shaking, slurred speech, drowsiness. A diabetic who fasts but still takes insulin is the commonest clinic cause.

plain.zh: 降血糖的針劑。禁食那天打法要調整，不能「照平常」。
plain.en: The injection that lowers blood sugar. On a fasting day the dose plan changes; 'as usual' is wrong.

plain.zh: 麻醉前一段時間不吃不喝，避免睡著後胃裡的東西跑進肺裡。清流質和固體的時間不一樣，門診不需要禁食。
plain.en: Not eating or drinking for a period before anaesthesia so stomach contents cannot enter the lungs. Clear fluids and solids have different times; a clinic visit needs no fasting at all.

plain.zh: 從腰椎之間打一針到脊髓液，讓下半身暫時沒感覺，病人醒著。腰椎動過手術的人，不一定打得到。
plain.en: An injection between the lumbar vertebrae into the spinal fluid; the lower body goes numb and the patient stays awake. After lumbar surgery it may not be possible.

plain.zh: 用骨頭和螺釘把幾節腰椎固定在一起的手術。融合過的節段之間，針進不去。
plain.en: An operation that fixes several lumbar vertebrae together with bone and screws. Between fused levels there is no space for a needle.

plain.zh: 醫師說清楚選項和風險，病人說清楚在乎什麼，一起決定。不是醫師決定後請病人簽名。
plain.en: The doctor lays out options and risks, the patient says what matters to them, and they decide together. Not a decision followed by a signature.

plain.zh: 上一次麻醉的紀錄：氣道好不好插、醒得順不順、有沒有發燒。家屬一句「上次很久才醒」，就值得去調。
plain.en: The record of the last anaesthetic: how the airway went, how the wake-up went, any fever. A relative saying 'he took ages to wake up last time' is reason enough to pull it.

plain.zh: 張口、看喉嚨、脖子活動度、下巴長短、牙齒。半身麻醉的病人也要看，因為計畫 B 永遠是全身麻醉。
plain.en: Mouth opening, the view of the throat, neck movement, jaw length, teeth. Spinal patients get it too, because plan B is always a general anaesthetic.

text.zh: 血壓計、血氧機、血糖機、體重計。門診的第一道篩子。
text.en: Blood-pressure cuff, pulse oximeter, glucose meter, scales. The clinic's first sieve.

text.zh: 門診也會有緊急狀況。口服糖、靜脈葡萄糖、腎上腺素、氧氣。每週核對一次效期。
text.en: Emergencies happen in clinics too: oral glucose, intravenous glucose, adrenaline, oxygen. Expiry dates checked weekly.

text.zh: 氣道評估最便宜的工具。張口、伸舌、看得到多少。
text.en: The cheapest airway tools there are. Open wide, tongue out, see how much you can see.

text.zh: 一個塑膠袋，七種藥。兩種抗血小板、胰島素、降壓藥、還有一瓶不知道誰給的保健品。
text.en: One plastic bag, seven medicines: two antiplatelets, insulin, blood-pressure tablets, and a supplement nobody can account for.

text.zh: 她不是「能爬兩層樓」，她是「每週日踩四十分鐘管風琴踏板不喘」。寫進紀錄。
text.en: Not 'two flights of stairs' but 'forty minutes on the organ pedals every Sunday without stopping'. Written in the record.

name.en: The clinic is a week ahead of theatre

text.zh: 術前評估門診的價值，是把手術當天會取消的理由提前找出來：沒停的藥、沒查的心雜音、沒問的家族史。當天取消，病人白禁食一次，刀房空一台。
text.en: A pre-assessment clinic exists to find, a week early, every reason a case would be cancelled on the day: the tablet not stopped, the murmur not checked, the family history not asked. A cancellation on the day costs the patient a fast and the theatre a slot.

name.zh: 支架與擇期手術的時間表

text.zh: 支架放進去的頭幾個月，支架內壁還沒長好，最怕血塊。擇期手術原則上延後，抗血小板藥能不停就不停，要停也只停一種、由心臟科一起決定。這是時間表的問題，不是勇氣的問題。
text.en: In the first months after a stent its lining has not healed and clot is the great danger. Elective surgery is postponed where possible; antiplatelets continue if at all possible, and if one must pause, cardiology decides which and when. It is a calendar problem, not a courage problem.

text.zh: 一個能爬兩層樓不停的病人，很多術前檢查都不會改變計畫。檢查是為了回答一個會改變做法的問題，不是為了「安心」。
text.en: A patient who climbs two flights without stopping rarely needs tests that would change the plan. A test is ordered to answer a question that changes what you do, not to feel reassured.

name.en: The red flag in the family history

text.zh: 「我們家有人麻醉後發高燒、差點死掉」不是閒聊。惡性高熱會遺傳，麻醉方式要整個改。一句話，改一張計畫。
text.en: 'Someone in our family nearly died of a fever after an anaesthetic' is not small talk. Malignant hyperthermia runs in families and changes the whole anaesthetic plan. One sentence, a new plan.

lines.zh: 名單：08:30 柯先生，疝氣修補，糖尿病、心臟支架。10:30 江老師，人工膝關節，備註「要半身」。
lines.en: List: 08:30 Mr Ko, hernia repair, diabetes and coronary stent. 10:30 Ms Chiang, knee replacement, note 'wants a spinal'.

lines.zh: 早。柯先生到了，坐在候診區，臉有點白。太太說他昨晚十二點後沒吃。打鼾很大聲，要篩睡眠呼吸中止。
lines.en: Morning. Mr Ko is here in the waiting area, a bit pale. His wife says nothing since midnight. He snores loudly, so we screen for sleep apnoea too.

lines.zh: 門診不用禁食啊。先量血糖，等一下叫他進來。
lines.en: There is no fasting for a clinic visit. Check his sugar first; I will call him in shortly.

lines.zh: 早。問你一個問題：術前評估門診是做什麼的？
lines.en: Morning. A question for you: what is a pre-assessment clinic for?

lines.zh: 評估風險、看氣道、決定要不要檢查……
lines.en: Assessing risk, the airway, deciding on tests...

lines.zh: 都對，但重點是：把手術那天會取消的理由，提前一週找出來。手術那天不是用來發現事情的。
lines.en: All true. But the point is to find, a week early, every reason the case would be cancelled on the day. The day of surgery is not for finding things out.

lines.zh: 門診也會有緊急狀況。口服糖、靜脈葡萄糖、腎上腺素、氧氣。效期一項一項看。
lines.en: Emergencies happen in clinics. Oral glucose, intravenous glucose, adrenaline, oxygen. Expiry dates one by one.

q.zh: 點選急救藥盒，確認口服糖還在裡面。
q.en: Tap the emergency drug box and confirm the oral glucose is there.

post.zh: 口服糖兩包，效期沒過。希望今天用不到。
post.en: Two sachets of oral glucose, in date. Hopefully not needed today.

note.zh: 柯先生的用藥與支架問題釐清
note.en: Mr Ko's medicines and stent sorted

lines.zh: 醫師，我沒吃早餐喔，很乖。藥都帶來了，一整袋。
lines.en: Doctor, I skipped breakfast, I was good. Brought all my pills, the whole bag.

lines.zh: 門診不用禁食，等一下先吃點東西。來，我們一包一包看。
lines.en: No fasting is needed for clinic; you will eat something shortly. Now, let us go through the bag one by one.

lines.zh: 我就說不用餓肚子。他就是不聽。
lines.en: I told him he did not need to starve. He never listens.

post.zh: 兩種抗血小板、胰島素、降壓藥。還有這瓶……誰給的？
post.en: Two antiplatelets, insulin, blood-pressure tablets. And this bottle... who gave you this?
The neighbour. Says it is good for the heart.

lines.zh: 半年前的心臟支架，兩種抗血小板都還在吃，疝氣修補是擇期手術。你會怎麼做？
lines.en: A coronary stent six months ago, still on dual antiplatelet therapy, and the hernia repair is elective. What would you do?

q.zh: 柯先生的支架與擇期手術，怎麼安排？
q.en: Mr Ko's stent and his elective hernia: what is the plan?

options.zh: 聯絡許醫師，共同決定時間與用藥
options.en: Call Dr Hsu; decide timing and tablets together

why.zh: 支架後擇期手術的時間與抗血小板藥的處理，是心臟科、外科、麻醉科一起決定的事。打電話不是示弱。
why.en: Timing of elective surgery after a stent, and what happens to the antiplatelets, is a joint decision between cardiology, surgery and anaesthesia. Picking up the phone is not weakness.

options.zh: 叫他手術前一週把兩種藥都停掉
options.en: Tell him to stop both tablets a week before

why.zh: 兩種同時停，支架在頭幾個月內很可能塞住，那是心肌梗塞。這個決定永遠不是門診自己做。
why.en: Stopping both in the first months risks the stent blocking: that is a heart attack. This decision is never made alone in clinic.

options.zh: 照常排刀，藥照吃，外科自己想辦法
options.en: Book it, keep the tablets, let surgery cope

why.zh: 外科醫師手術當天看到雙重抗血小板，很可能取消。這正是門診要提前處理的事。
why.en: A surgeon who finds dual antiplatelet therapy on the day will very likely cancel. Exactly what this clinic exists to handle a week early.

post.zh: 記住：這是時間表的問題，不是勇氣的問題。
post.en: Remember: this is a calendar problem, not a courage problem.

lines.zh: 所以那兩顆心臟的藥，要不要停？我鄰居說手術前都要停。
lines.en: So those two heart tablets, do I stop them? My neighbour says you always stop before surgery.

lines.zh: 鄰居的藥和你的藥不一樣。抗血小板藥不是抗凝血劑，支架的病人更不能自己停。
lines.en: Your neighbour's tablets are not yours. Antiplatelets are not anticoagulants, and a stent patient must never stop them on his own.

post.en: Did you hear that? Not on your own.

note.zh: 候診區的低血糖處理完成
note.en: Hypoglycaemia in the waiting area handled

lines.zh: 醫師！他在冒汗，講話怪怪的！
lines.en: Doctor! He is sweating and talking strangely!

lines.zh: 柯先生坐在椅子上，額頭都是汗，手在抖，說要回去修水管。
lines.en: Mr Ko is on the chair, forehead wet, hands shaking, saying he has to go and fix a pipe.

options.zh: 測血糖；能吞嚥就給口服糖，依醫囑
options.en: Check glucose; oral glucose if he can swallow, per protocol

why.zh: 糖尿病人、空腹、胰島素照打、冒汗手抖：先想低血糖。能吞嚥就口服，不能就靜脈，依醫囑。
why.en: Diabetic, fasting, insulin taken, sweating and shaking: think hypoglycaemia first. Oral if he can swallow, intravenous if not, per protocol.

options.en: Call an ambulance to the emergency department

why.zh: 送急診沒有錯，但他現在就需要糖。先處理，再決定要不要送。
why.en: Not wrong to send him, but he needs sugar now. Treat first, decide on transfer after.

options.zh: 讓他躺下休息，等一下就好
options.en: Lie him down and wait it out

why.zh: 低血糖不會自己好，只會變成抽搐和昏迷。
why.en: Hypoglycaemia does not resolve on its own; it turns into seizures and coma.

post.zh: 血糖機在這裡。他吞得下去，口服糖給了。
post.en: Glucose meter here. He can swallow; oral glucose given.

lines.zh: （走過來）處理得好。現在把順序講一遍給游護理師聽，她下次自己做。
lines.en: (walking over) Well handled. Now talk the sequence through for Nurse Yu so she can run it alone next time.

q.zh: 候診區低血糖的處理順序
q.en: Hypoglycaemia in the waiting area: the order of steps

steps.zh: 找原因：空腹卻照打胰島素
steps.en: Find the cause: fasted but took insulin

lines.zh: 好了，他在吃游護理師的餅乾。為什麼會發生？
lines.en: Right, he is eating Nurse Yu's biscuits. Why did this happen?

lines.zh: 他以為來醫院就要禁食，昨晚後沒吃，胰島素照平常打。
lines.en: He thought a hospital visit meant fasting, ate nothing after last night and took his usual insulin.

lines.zh: 對。手術那天也會一模一樣，除非我們今天把胰島素的打法交代清楚。來。
lines.en: Yes. And the day of surgery will go exactly the same way unless we explain the insulin plan today. Go on.

post.zh: 所以手術那天早上，胰島素要照你們寫的打，不是照平常。我記住了。
post.en: So on the morning of surgery I take the insulin the way you write it, not the usual way. Got it.

note.zh: 等候區的口香糖處理完成

sub.zh: 等候區的病人在嚼口香糖
sub.en: A patient in the holding bay is chewing gum

lines.zh: 醫師，第二台的病人在等候區嚼口香糖，說「又不是吃東西」。外科已經在刷手了。
lines.en: Doctor, the second case is chewing gum in the holding bay and says 'it is not food'. The surgeon is already scrubbing.

lines.zh: 謝謝你看到。口香糖吐掉，我們算一下，順便看他還有沒有別的沒說。
lines.en: Thanks for spotting it. Gum out, let us work through the timing, and check whether there is anything else he has not mentioned.

post.zh: 好，我跟麻醉護理師說。下次我會在門口就問「嘴巴裡有東西嗎」。
post.en: Right, I will tell the nurse anaesthetist. Next time I will ask 'anything in your mouth?' at the door.

note.zh: 江老師的麻醉計畫與共同決策完成

lines.zh: 醫師，我朋友換膝蓋是打半身的，很舒服，還跟醫師聊天。我也要那個。
lines.en: Doctor, my friend had a spinal for her knee, very comfortable, chatted with the doctor the whole time. I want that one.

lines.zh: 可以考慮。先問你平常能做什麼？爬樓梯會喘嗎？
lines.en: It is an option. First, what can you do day to day? Breathless on stairs?

lines.zh: 喘什麼？我每個禮拜天踩管風琴踏板四十分鐘，巴哈。
lines.en: Breathless? I do forty minutes on the organ pedals every Sunday. Bach.

lines.zh: 這個功能容量比心電圖好用。不過脊椎麻醉也要做氣道評估，因為計畫 B 永遠是全身麻醉。張嘴，啊——
lines.en: That functional capacity is worth more than an ECG. But spinal anaesthesia still needs an airway assessment, because plan B is always a general. Open wide, ah...

lines.zh: 側彎加十年前的腰椎融合。先用手摸：節段找得到嗎？疤痕在哪一段？
lines.en: Scoliosis plus a fusion ten years ago. Hands first: can you find the levels? Where does the scar sit?

lines.zh: 你們在找什麼？
lines.en: What are you looking for?

lines.zh: 找還沒被螺釘封住的縫。
lines.en: A gap the screws have not closed.

post.zh: 疤痕中段摸不到間隙，上面一節好像還有。歪的。
post.en: No space under the middle of the scar; one level above may still be open. Crooked.

guide.zh: 看她的腰椎 X 光

lines.zh: 影像調出來。融合過的腰椎，脊椎麻醉要注意什麼？
lines.en: Pull up the images. What does a fused lumbar spine mean for a spinal anaesthetic?

question.zh: 腰椎融合之後，脊椎麻醉要注意什麼？
question.en: After a lumbar fusion, what changes for a spinal anaesthetic?

answer.zh: 融合的節段被骨頭和螺釘封住，針只能從融合以上或以下還開著的間隙進。疤痕讓定位和穿刺變難，藥在脊髓液裡的擴散也可能不均，阻斷可能不完整。所以要先告訴病人：可能打不到、可能要改全身麻醉。
answer.en: Fused levels are sealed by bone and screws; the needle can only enter an open space above or below the fusion. Scar makes landmarks and the puncture harder, and spread in the spinal fluid may be patchy, so the block can be incomplete. The patient must hear beforehand that it may not work and may become a general.

lines.zh: 江老師，半身麻醉可以試，但因為融合手術，可能打不到或麻得不完整。真的不行，就改全身麻醉。
lines.en: Ms Chiang, we can try a spinal, but because of the fusion it may not go in or may not be complete. If it fails we switch to a general.

lines.zh: 那我會不會醒不來？
lines.en: Then will I wake up?

lines.zh: 會。而且醒來第一件事可以哼巴哈給我們聽。這是共同決策：你知道兩條路，你選。
lines.en: You will. And the first thing you can do is hum us some Bach. This is shared decision-making: you know both roads, you choose.

lines.zh: 那就先試半身，不行就睡。我選了。
lines.en: Try the spinal first, and if not, I sleep. Decided.

note.zh: 柯先生的支架計畫定案

sub.zh: 柯先生的支架與疝氣手術
sub.en: Mr Ko's stent and his hernia

lines.zh: 麻醉科嗎？柯先生的事，謝謝你們先打來。支架半年，建議再等幾個月；阿斯匹靈不停，另一種到時候我來寫。
lines.en: Anaesthesia? About Mr Ko, thank you for calling first. Six months after the stent, I suggest waiting a few more months; aspirin continues throughout, and I will write how to pause the other one when the time comes.

lines.zh: 好，我把你的建議寫進評估，外科那邊我去說。
lines.en: Good. I will write your advice into the assessment and speak to the surgeons.

sub.en: Who told Mr Ko to stop his tablets?

lines.zh: 麻醉科嗎？柯先生剛打給我，說門診叫他兩種藥都停一週。支架半年，兩種都停？
lines.en: Anaesthesia? Mr Ko just rang me; he says clinic told him to stop both tablets for a week. Six months after a stent, both?

lines.zh: ……是我說的。我想得太快。請你幫我重新交代他。
lines.en: ...That was me. I decided too quickly. Please help me re-brief him.

lines.zh: 已經交代了：一顆都不停，手術延後幾個月。下次先打給我，好嗎？
lines.en: Already done: nothing stops, surgery waits a few months. Next time, call me first, would you?

sub.zh: 柯先生的刀：麻醉說可以？
sub.en: Mr Ko's case: did anaesthesia say go?

lines.zh: 外科的訊息：「柯先生排下週，麻醉評估說可以？他還在吃兩種抗血小板。」
lines.en: Message from surgery: 'Mr Ko is booked for next week; anaesthesia cleared him? He is still on two antiplatelets.'

lines.zh: （看著你）這就是手術當天會取消的那一台。現在打給許醫師，還來得及。
lines.en: (looking at you) That is the case that gets cancelled on the day. Call Dr Hsu now; there is still time.

lines.zh: 打了。許醫師說延後幾個月，阿斯匹靈不停。
lines.en: Done. Dr Hsu says wait a few months and keep the aspirin going.

note.zh: 紀錄完成，方主治的反思

lines.zh: 柯先生：ASA 分級第三級，支架半年，擇期手術延後，手術日胰島素打法寫清楚。江老師：先試脊椎麻醉，備全麻，知情。
lines.en: Mr Ko: ASA class three, stent at six months, elective surgery deferred, insulin plan for the day written out. Ms Chiang: spinal first, general on standby, patient informed.

lines.zh: 游護理師的名單：明天手術的每一個病人，今晚各打一通：禁食時間、哪些藥照吃、哪些藥停。
lines.en: Nurse Yu's list: every patient on tomorrow's list gets a call tonight: fasting times, which tablets to take, which to hold.

lines.zh: 柯先生我會多打一通。他就是不聽。
lines.en: Mr Ko gets an extra call. He never listens.

lines.zh: 今天最有價值的一句話是誰說的？
lines.en: Whose words were the most valuable today?

lines.zh: 江老師的「踩四十分鐘管風琴」。還有柯太太的「他就是不聽」。
lines.en: Ms Chiang's 'forty minutes on the organ pedals'. And Mrs Ko's 'he never listens'.

lines.zh: 對。一個告訴你功能容量，一個告訴你衛教要寫給誰看。門診就是聽。回家吧。
lines.en: Yes. One tells you the functional capacity, the other tells you who the instructions must be written for. Clinic is listening. Go home.

note.zh: 家族史的紅旗處理完成

sub.zh: 明天病人的女兒說了一句話
sub.en: Tomorrow's patient: something his daughter said

lines.zh: 醫師，明天第一台的伯伯，女兒剛剛隨口說「爸爸上次開刀很久才醒，舅舅麻醉後發高燒差點死掉」。我想說還是打給你。
lines.en: Doctor, tomorrow's first case: his daughter just mentioned in passing that 'dad took ages to wake up last time, and my uncle nearly died of a fever after an anaesthetic'. I thought I had better call.

lines.zh: 你打對了。這不是閒聊，這是紅旗。舊麻醉紀錄現在就調。
lines.en: Right call. That is not small talk, that is a red flag. We pull the previous anaesthetic record now.

post.zh: （訊息）家族史裡的惡性高熱，整個麻醉方式都要改。明天早上我提早到，我們一起重寫計畫。
post.en: (message) Malignant hyperthermia in the family changes the whole technique. I will be in early tomorrow; we rewrite the plan together.

lines.zh: 你把「家族史：疑似惡性高熱」寫在明天計畫的第一行，粗體。然後想起柯先生的餅乾。
lines.en: You write 'family history: possible malignant hyperthermia' as the first line of tomorrow's plan, in bold. Then you remember Mr Ko's biscuits.

lines.zh: （訊息）女兒說謝謝你有聽。晚安。
lines.en: (message) The daughter says thank you for listening. Good night.

sub.zh: 一袋藥、一雙踩踏板的腳、一句隨口的話
sub.en: A bag of pills, a pair of organ-pedal feet, one passing remark
